name: @vantageos/mcp-doctor
stderr:
usage: mcp-doctor <source-tree-path> [--mode=static|dynamic|both] [--backend=<convex-dir>] [--json]

  --mode=static   read the tree only (default)
  --mode=dynamic  launch the server and judge what it serves
  --mode=both     both, dynamic findings taking precedence
  --local-identity-ceiling=N
                  local identity primitives tolerated before DLocalIdentity
                  fails (default 0)
  --backend=DIR   the backend source (a convex/ dir) whose door list S-28 reads;
                  default: the nearest convex/ above the tree
  --json          print the report as JSON (results, owedHumanVerdicts, exitCode)
  --version       print the version and exit
  --help          print this and exit

exit: 0 clean, 1 a violation, 2 an abstention with no violation
